purpose: Combine the strongest proven GVAULT/GThink decisions since 2026-08-24 without replacing working architecture or weakening public/private boundaries.

stagingFirst.rule: Develop on isolated staging, preserve a clean checkpoint, test, then integrate only if functional/coherent/persistent/responsive/secure/performance-safe and rollbackable.

SACREBLEU.use: Multi-source reconstruction/double validation when a route, memory or artifact needs recovery; do not assume an existing branch is sufficient proof.

BaGeCaToProdOui.use: Convert important ideas into real testable implementations rather than passive descriptions.

FiCsa.use: For recovery or ambiguous history, walk the reverse path first, then the normal path.

GThink22Families.use: Use the narrowest authoritative route and preserve full facts/evidence/provenance rather than a lossy summary when research is persisted.

bestFunctionalSep1.use: Preserve explicit user intent and canonical Method Router; derived indexes/cadastres/semantic markers are support only; adapt later improvements instead of destructive rollback.

multiPlaneBlobFabric.use: Keep public/private/image/tool planes isolated; exchange descriptors/results through controlled routes; EDGE_DOWN must not imply CORE_DOWN.

firstCaptureLedger.use: Git evidence remains canonical for conversation capture; derived indexes may lag and must not become interpretation authority.
